channel.title: IMMA News
channel.description: Kenya's news, insights and essential information from IMMA News, a publication of IMMA Media.

item.title: China Flies Its First Foreign Astronaut as Pakistan's Zeeshan Ali Heads to Tiangong
item.description: The Shenzhou-24 spacecraft has lifted off from northwest China carrying two Chinese astronauts and Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, the first non-Chinese astronaut to visit China's space station.

item.title: US Jury Finds Huawei Guilty of Trade Secrets Conspiracy and Bank Fraud
item.description: A federal jury in Brooklyn has convicted the Chinese telecoms giant on 10 of 12 counts but cleared it of racketeering, the most serious charge. Huawei says it will appeal.

item.title: Ruto Adds Ksh5 Billion to Hustler Fund and Lifts Loans to Ksh150,000
item.description: President Ruto says the government will add a further Ksh5 billion to the Hustler Fund and move about 4.5 million regular borrowers to a loan product offering up to Ksh150,000 each.

item.title: KWS Begins Rhino-by-Rhino Count at Ol Pejeta After 17 Deaths
item.description: Wildlife officials have started an audit of the black rhinos at Ol Pejeta Conservancy in Laikipia after 17 died this year. The conservancy says none of the deaths was caused by poaching.

item.title: eCitizen Users Told to Change Passwords as Government Probes Hacking Claim
item.description: The State Department for Immigration and Citizen Services says it is investigating online reports that hackers took data from eCitizen. It has not confirmed a breach, but is urging users to switch to strong, unique passwords.

item.title: Before He Became Mzee: The Fascinating Life of Jomo Kenyatta Before Politics
item.description: An orphan, a livestock herder, a carpenter and a water-meter reader. Discover the man before the presidency.

item.title: How to Apply for a Kenyan Passport in 2026: Fees, Requirements and Step-by-Step Guide
item.description: Applying for a Kenyan passport is largely an online process, but applicants must attend an immigration centre in person for document verification and biometric capture. This guide explains the requirements, fees, eCitizen procedure and passport collection in 2026.

item.title: 7 High-Protein, High-Fibre Kenyan Meals for Healthy Weight Management
item.description: Balanced meals rich in protein and dietary fibre help promote fullness and steady energy. Here are seven affordable, flavourful Kenyan-inspired recipes with estimated nutrition and practical preparation tips.

item.title: Medically Assisted Weight Loss: Safe Options and Medical Support Explained
item.description: Managing weight safely often involves more than willpower alone. This guide outlines medically supervised programmes, prescription treatments, procedures, safety risks, and how to access care in Kenya.

item.title: Liverpool Thrash Manchester United 4-0 in Premier League Showdown
item.description: Liverpool secured an emphatic 4-0 victory over ten-man Manchester United on Sunday, November 22, in a difficult first match for United manager Mauricio Pochettino.

item.title: Kabras Sugar Defeat KCB 20-15 in Kenya Cup Season Opener
item.description: Defending champions Kabras Sugar began their 2026/27 Kenya Cup campaign with a 20-15 victory over rivals KCB Rugby in Kakamega. Rayvone Ambale scored twice as the champions extended their remarkable unbeaten run.

item.title: Kenya's Mirriam Cherop Wins Thrilling Cross-Country Race in Spain
item.description: Kenyan distance runner Mirriam Cherop produced a powerful finishing sprint to win the women's race at the Cross Internacional de Atapuerca in Spain, defeating two Ethiopian challengers in a World Athletics Cross Country Tour Gold event.

item.title: Opposition Quits IEBC Talks, Saying 2027 Reform Concerns Were Ignored
item.description: Rigathi Gachagua and other opposition figures left a consultative session with the electoral commission, complaining that the issues they wanted discussed had been left off the programme. President William Ruto hit back hours later.

item.title: Nine Killed in Two Nairobi Construction Collapses in Two Days
item.description: An unfinished eight-storey block near the SGR terminus came down on Friday, killing six. Less than a day later, a wall at a Riverside excavation site fell on workers, killing at least three.
